_comment: Tier-0 Wood-side gather material. Pale fungal growth on the trunks and lower limbs of certain pines; rarer than bark or earth, and the quality of the find varies more sharply. Hell cannot heal -- materials for medicinal preparations are gathered above, never below.
name: Pale lichen
description: A grey-green crust prised from the bark, brittle as parchment when dry and faintly bitter at the touch. The underside still bears the imprint of the tree it grew on.
